preconditions.description: Number of balls is between 2 and 200,000.
Number of swaps is between 1 and 200,000.
Initial position of the special ball is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in swaps)
preconditions.description: Each swap involves two distinct positions between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output is an integer.
Each element in the output is either -1 or a non-negative integer.
The minimum number of swaps to move the special ball to its initial position is 0.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or (i+1 in reachable_positions) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If the special ball can reach position i+1, then output[i] is not -1.
